issues.current_text: O IRGC classificou Jebel Ali, Khalifa e Fujairah como "alvos legítimos"
issues.previous_text: A IRGC ameaçou os portos de Jebel Ali e Khalifa nos Emirados como "próximos alvos legítimos."
issues.suggestion: This is the exact same IRGC threat reported yesterday. Cut the Jebel Ali/Khalifa line entirely — it's not new. The new development is the actual Fujairah fire; focus on that instead.

issues.current_text: A GTC 2026 abriu hoje em San Jose com mais de 30 mil participantes de 190 países e 1.000 sessões centradas em IA agêntica e inferência. O keynote de Jensen Huang amanhã deve formalizar a arquitetura Vera Rubin e o NemoClaw
issues.previous_text: Na véspera da GTC... Jensen Huang sobe ao palco domingo para apresentar o Vera CPU de 88 núcleos... e a plataforma Rubin com 288 GB de HBM4 e até 50 petaFLOPS
issues.suggestion: Yesterday's edition already previewed GTC, Vera Rubin, and Huang's keynote in detail (88 cores, HBM4 specs, Groq acquisition). Today should focus only on what actually happened at the opening — new announcements, surprises, attendee reactions — not re-preview what was already previewed. Drop the Vera Rubin mention or add genuinely new specs/details not covered yesterday.

issues.current_text: A IEA discute liberação coordenada de reservas estratégicas, mas analistas alertam que reservas não resolvem a interrupção logística.
issues.previous_text: Washington liberou 172 milhões de barris da Reserva Estratégica
issues.suggestion: Strategic reserves were already covered on 03/13 (172M barrels released) and IEA was featured on 03/14 (classified Hormuz as biggest disruption). Today's IEA mention adds little. Either cut or only include if there's a concrete new decision (e.g., specific volume, participating countries).

issues.current_text: humanoides Digit da Agility Robotics na fábrica do RAV4 em Woodstock
issues.previous_text: Renault vai colocar 350 robôs humanoides Calvin da Wandercraft em suas fábricas nos próximos 18 meses
issues.suggestion: Humanoid robots in auto factories appeared on 03/12 (Renault/Calvin, 350 units) and 03/13 (Tesla Optimus Gen 3, 10M units/year). Toyota/Digit is only 7 units — far less significant. This is the third consecutive 'humanoids enter car factory' story. Cut or compress to a single sentence noting the trend rather than treating it as standalone news.

issues.previous_text: Brent fechou a US$103,14 (03/14); Brent por volta de $100/barril (03/13); Brent oscila em torno de $100 (03/12)
issues.suggestion: Brent price has been reported in all four consecutive editions hovering around $100. Today it's $101 but was $103 yesterday — which is actually lower, not a 'jump.' The 9% intraday move is newsworthy but frame it relative to recent context: 'WTI hit $119 intraday after Kharg strikes — the largest single-session gain in history — though Brent settled near the $100 level it's held all week.'

issues.current_text: o chanceler Araghchi pediu aos estados do Golfo que expulsem forças americanas
issues.previous_text: todas as bases americanas no Oriente Médio devem fechar imediatamente — "essas bases serão atacadas"
issues.suggestion: Iran demanding US forces leave the Gulf was covered on 03/13 (Khamenei's first statement). Araghchi's version is diplomatically softer but substantively identical. Cut or note the diplomatic downgrade: 'Araghchi softened Khamenei's ultimatum into a diplomatic request.'

issues.current_text: Na corrida por soberania em silício, Musk confirmou que a Terafab da Tesla lança em sete dias
issues.previous_text: a demanda por silício avançado já ultrapassa a capacidade de fabricá-lo (03/14); TSMC registrou receita recorde... dominância se aprofunda (03/12)
issues.suggestion: The 'silicon race/shortage' narrative has appeared in 3 of the last 4 editions (03/12: TSMC dominance, 03/14: silicon shortage, 03/15: silicon sovereignty). Terafab is genuinely new but frame it around what Tesla specifically gains (FSD, Optimus supply chain) rather than recycling the macro 'race for chips' angle.

issues.current_text: Na terceira semana do conflito, um míssil atingiu o heliponto da embaixada americana em Bagdá e destroços de drones incendiaram o terminal de petróleo de Fujairah. O IRGC classificou... Araghchi pediu... Trump rejeitou... convocou... França recusou... 5 mil fuzileiros...
issues.previous_text: A Arábia Saudita interceptou 51 drones... IRGC ameaçou... OIM alerta 3 mil navios presos... (03/14); Mojtaba Khamenei emitiu... Hormuz fechado... drones contra Saudita... explosões Dubai... Israel 20 ondas de ataques... (03/13)
issues.suggestion: The war paragraph follows the same structure every day: list of attacks → diplomatic threat → retaliation → escalation → casualty/ship count. Four days of this reads like a log, not journalism. Pick ONE lead development (embassy strike or Kharg Island — both are genuinely new), give it proper context, and link to a rolling tracker for the rest. The enumeration fatigue is real.

issues.current_text: Meta prepara demissões de até 20% da força de trabalho... para financiar $600 bilhões em infraestrutura de IA até 2028
issues.previous_text: Meta adiou o lançamento do modelo Avocado... $135 bilhões projetados para infraestrutura de IA em 2026
issues.suggestion: Meta's massive AI spending framed as 'pouring billions into AI infrastructure' appeared two days ago ($135B). Today's $600B figure is different (longer time horizon) but the framing — Meta sacrificing X to fund AI — is identical. Lead with the human angle (16,000 jobs, Altman's 'AI-washing' critique) rather than the infrastructure dollar figure, which readers have seen repeatedly.

issues.current_text: senadores americanos investigam Meta, OpenAI e xAI por data centers a gás natural cujos projetos emitiriam 12,1 bilhões de toneladas de CO2
issues.previous_text: No apetite energético da própria IA (framing device within 03/15 oil paragraph)
issues.suggestion: Placing the AI energy/emissions story inside the oil price paragraph creates a forced thematic link. This is a regulatory/environmental story, not an oil market story. Move it to the tech section or cut — it feels shoehorned as a 'bridge' from war coverage to other topics.

summary: High repetition — the IRGC/Jebel Ali threat is a direct duplicate from yesterday, GTC/Vera Rubin re-previews what 03/14 already covered, and the war paragraph follows an identical escalation-list structure for the 4th consecutive day. Humanoid-robots-in-factories is the 3rd instance in 4 days. Oil price reporting around $100 appears in all 4 editions.
